license_and_usage: Kaggle Home Credit Default Risk competition rules apply to the real data; must be accepted on Kaggle. Synthetic fixture: no license, internal use only.
target_meaning: TARGET=1: client with payment difficulties (late payment beyond the dataset-defined threshold on at least one of the first installments); TARGET=0: all other cases. Confirm against HomeCredit_columns_description.csv when using real data.

feature_descriptions.name: AMT_INCOME_TOTAL
feature_descriptions.meaning: Total declared income of the client

feature_descriptions.name: AMT_CREDIT
feature_descriptions.meaning: Credit amount of the loan

feature_descriptions.name: AMT_ANNUITY
feature_descriptions.meaning: Loan annuity (periodic payment)

feature_descriptions.name: AMT_GOODS_PRICE
feature_descriptions.meaning: Price of the goods for which the loan is granted

feature_descriptions.name: AGE_YEARS
feature_descriptions.meaning: Client age in years. This IS the canonical model column; the raw file's DAYS_BIRTH (negative day-count) is converted to it once during ingestion, so training and serving share it.

feature_descriptions.name: EMPLOYMENT_YEARS
feature_descriptions.meaning: Years employed at current job. Canonical model column derived once at ingestion from DAYS_EMPLOYED; the documented 365243 sentinel (pensioners/unemployed) becomes missing with a DAYS_EMPLOYED_MISSING indicator. Omit at serving for pensioners/unemployed -> flag set, value imputed.

feature_descriptions.name: CNT_FAM_MEMBERS
feature_descriptions.meaning: Number of family members

feature_descriptions.name: CNT_CHILDREN
feature_descriptions.meaning: Number of children the client has

feature_descriptions.name: EXT_SOURCE_1
feature_descriptions.meaning: Normalized score from external data source 1

feature_descriptions.name: EXT_SOURCE_2
feature_descriptions.meaning: Normalized score from external data source 2

feature_descriptions.name: EXT_SOURCE_3
feature_descriptions.meaning: Normalized score from external data source 3

feature_descriptions.name: REGION_POPULATION_RELATIVE
feature_descriptions.meaning: Normalized population of the region where the client lives

feature_descriptions.name: NAME_CONTRACT_TYPE
feature_descriptions.meaning: Loan type: cash or revolving

feature_descriptions.name: CODE_GENDER
feature_descriptions.meaning: Gender of the client

feature_descriptions.name: FLAG_OWN_CAR
feature_descriptions.meaning: Whether the client owns a car

feature_descriptions.name: FLAG_OWN_REALTY
feature_descriptions.meaning: Whether the client owns real estate

feature_descriptions.name: NAME_INCOME_TYPE
feature_descriptions.meaning: Client's income source

feature_descriptions.name: NAME_EDUCATION_TYPE
feature_descriptions.meaning: Highest level of education achieved

feature_descriptions.name: NAME_FAMILY_STATUS
feature_descriptions.meaning: Family status of the client

feature_descriptions.name: NAME_HOUSING_TYPE
feature_descriptions.meaning: Housing situation of the client

feature_descriptions.name: OCCUPATION_TYPE
feature_descriptions.meaning: Occupation of the client (often missing in real data)

known_limitations: Serving subset uses application-level features only; supporting tables (bureau, previous_application, ...) are an offline/advanced extension and not required for a single real-time prediction.
DAYS_EMPLOYED uses the documented 365243 sentinel for pensioners/unemployed; treated as missing with an indicator.
